{{Quote|It's not pretty, but it works.|Kem Monnon and the Corps of Engineers|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Corps of Engineers''' was a division of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that specialized in engineering and construction. Under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]], the Corps was responsible for the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], beginning construction in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and finishing in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
